evidence.exact_span: Of the 'available funds' identified at para 12 of the administrators' draft report, it appears that the real property (Lots 11, 12 and 13 at Coomera), the cause of action against the MKM Group, the Gold Coast City Council security bond and the debt in respect of funds advanced for the acquisition a residential unit in the Belrose Country Club each form part of the trust fund of the Barr Trust.
